summary: Another player may instantly Charge one ability; cannot be used within 20' of a living enemy.

effects.subject: target
effects.note: Target player may instantly Charge a single ability (no Charge Incantation).

requirements.note: May not be used within 20' of a living enemy.

open_questions: L1 does not say whether the 20' is measured from the caster, the target, or both; recorded with the standard no-enemy-within-20ft requirement (caster).
E1 does not say whether the target must Charge immediately or may choose later, nor whether the ability must have a listed Charge value.
